text:
Sara (AE): Hey team — Prospect (ZenHealth) asked for SSO/SAML + conditional access evidence for the SIG questionnaire. They specifically want: MFA enforcement, session timeout handling, RBAC for admin vs app roles, and privileged session controls. Need to send a proof pack by EOD Thursday.
Alex Chang: Got it. Can we split up artifacts? I can do SAML metadata + screenshots of the SSO settings and SAML attribute mapping.
Mike S.: I’ll handle MFA enforcement, conditional access rules, and logs showing enforcement. Quick Q: do they want device-based conditional access or just IP blocks?
Sara (AE): They mentioned device posture preferred but said IP allowlist is acceptable as fallback. Call out both.
Linda G.: I’ll put together RBAC and least-privilege docs — role matrix, example role bindings, and a sample IAM policy for service accounts.
Alex Chang: For SAML metadata, I’ll include: Identity Provider metadata (IdP entityID + cert thumbprint), AssertionConsumerService URL, NameID format, and example attribute mappings (email, groups, role). Will include a screenshot of the SAML test sign-in.
Mike S.: For MFA enforcement, we enforce MFA at authn time for all interactive sessions. Evidence I’ll attach: conditional access rule screenshot, authentication logs with MFA event id lines, and a short CSV extract showing timestamps and user ids. Example log snippet:
```
2026-03-10T15:12:02Z user=j.tan@zenhealth.com event=login status=challenge_mfa method=totp result=success
2026-03-10T15:12:07Z user=j.tan@zenhealth.com event=session_create ttl=3600 session_id=abc123
```
Linda G.: RBAC notes — we have three tiers: org-admin (very limited), tenant-admin (manage models & routes), app-engineer (deploy/run). Example least-privilege binding:
```
role: "redwood.app-deployer"
permissions: ["deploy:models","invoke:routes","read:metrics"]
principals: ["group:ml-eng@redwood.com"]
```
Alex Chang: For privileged sessions, we support short-lived elevation via approval flow + audit trail. I’ll add a screenshot of the elevation modal and the audit log entry format.
Sara (AE): Can we also provide a short note on service accounts and scoped tokens for customer POCs? They want assurance we don’t use broad keys.
Linda G.: Yep — evidence: example service account policy, example token TTL (default 1h, refresh with rotation), and a note about HSM/KMS integration for key storage.
Mike S.: Also adding SIEM integration proof — we forward auth & audit events to customer Splunk/Datadog via secure connector. I’ll include an eventflow diagram link and a sample forwarded event (redacted).
SecurityBot: Automated scan complete — no open critical findings for SSO/RBAC subsystems in last 30 days. Scan report: https://redwood-internal/reports/sso-rbac-scan-2026-03-15.pdf
Alex Chang: Plan for pack: 1) SAML metadata + screenshots, 2) MFA & conditional access screenshots + log extracts, 3) RBAC matrix & service-account policies, 4) privileged session audit examples, 5) SIEM forwarding diagram + sample events, 6) short cover letter mapping to SIG/CAIQ questions. Deliver by Thu 17:00 PT.
Sara (AE): Perfect — I’ll assemble into a zip and upload to the secure artifact share, and send to ZenHealth security contact. Who wants review before I send?
Mike S.: I can do a security review quick pass Wed AM.
Linda G.: I’ll review RBAC docs Wed afternoon.
Alex Chang: I’ll QA the SAML screenshots and logs Wed evening.
Sara (AE): Awesome — thanks team. I’ll create a follow-up thread with the artifact link once uploaded. :thumbsup:
